ai-digital-skills.title: AI & Digital Skills
ai-digital-skills.blurb: Learn the basics of artificial intelligence, digital safety, and online communication.

levels.title: Level 1: Friendly Tech Start
levels.summary: Meet AI, explore safe passwords, and learn calm online chats.

lessons.title: Lesson 1 — What is AI?
lessons.summary: AI is a helpful robot inside your phone that suggests and guides.

content.intro: Imagine AI as a friendly helper that notices what you like and recommends things.
bullets: Helps you find places, songs, and routes.
You stay in charge of every choice.

quiz.question: AI is like...
options: a helpful robot in your device

lessons.title: Lesson 2 — Using Computers & Phones Safely
lessons.summary: Use strong passwords and avoid strange links.

content.intro: Be a tech superhero: protect your device from bad links and scammers.
bullets: Mix letters, numbers, and symbols in passwords.
Avoid links that yell or look fake.
Ask a trusted person if unsure.

lessons.title: Lesson 3 — AI in Everyday Life
lessons.summary: Spot AI helpers around you—maps, music, and photos.

content.intro: AI quietly powers maps, playlists, and even your camera brightness.

lessons.title: Lesson 4 — Talking to AI & Being Kind Online
lessons.summary: Ask clear questions and use kind words online.

content.intro: Talking to AI is like chatting with a friendly robot—be clear and kind.
bullets: Double-check important info with a person.

quiz.question: Check important info with a person?

lessons.title: Lesson 5 — Making a Strong Password
lessons.summary: Create a superhero-style password and keep it secret.

content.intro: A strong password protects your accounts from sneaky villains.
bullets: Choose words not tied to birthdays.

lessons.title: Lesson 6 — Safe Searching on the Internet
lessons.summary: Spot safe websites and close suspicious pages.

content.intro: Safe sites look clean, avoid pop-ups, and often end in .gov or .edu.
bullets: Close weird tabs and ask for help.
Trust clear spelling and simple layouts.
Never enter private info on random sites.

lessons.title: Lesson 7 — Using Email Safely
lessons.summary: Spot fake emails and only open trusted messages.

content.intro: Fake emails often shout, have typos, or ask for bank info—skip them.
bullets: Open emails from people you know.
Real companies never ask for passwords by email.

lessons.title: Lesson 8 — Social Media Safety
lessons.summary: Keep accounts private and think before you post.

content.intro: Stay safe by sharing only kind words and no private details.
bullets: Avoid posting address or bank info.

lessons.title: Lesson 9 — Using AI in Everyday Life
lessons.summary: Use AI to plan days, make lists, and find ideas.

content.intro: AI can draft polite messages, suggest meals, and simplify routines.
bullets: Use AI to plan shopping lists.
You choose what advice to follow.

lessons.title: Lesson 10 — Staying Calm with Tech
lessons.summary: Tech breaks happen—breathe and try simple fixes.

content.intro: Use the Take 3 rule: breathe in, out, and try again—restart or ask for help.
bullets: Close weird tabs and ask a trusted person.

content.intro: Welcome to your first AI & Digital Skills adventure. Everything here is calm and easy to follow.
steps: Discover simple examples of AI you see every day like voice assistants.
Practice making strong passwords and keeping them in a safe place.
Learn the 'pause and breathe' rule before posting messages.
Try asking for help from a trusted adult when something feels confusing online.

levels.title: Level 2: Smart Searching & Safety
levels.summary: Search the web kindly and spot tricky links.

content.intro: Let's build calm habits for browsing the web.
steps: Use short keywords and filters to find friendly sources.
Check website addresses and icons before clicking links.
Create a simple screen-time plan with breaks and movement.
Practice reporting harmful messages with a support person.

levels.title: Level 3: Creating with AI
levels.summary: Make creative prompts and share safely.

content.intro: Turn ideas into calm creative projects with AI.
steps: Write short prompts with feelings, colors, or sounds you enjoy.
Save your projects in organized folders with simple names.
Ask a support person to review anything before sharing.
Celebrate small wins and stretch breaks between tasks.

math-numbers.title: Math & Numbers
math-numbers.blurb: Improve counting, handling money, telling time, and solving gentle puzzles.

levels.title: Level 1: Everyday Numbers
levels.summary: Counting, matching coins, and reading clocks.

lessons.title: Lesson 1 — Number Basics & Counting
lessons.summary: Count friendly objects and say numbers aloud.

content.intro: Use items you like to practice counting slowly.
bullets: Group items by tens for fun.

lessons.title: Lesson 2 — Money Skills for Daily Life
lessons.summary: Know coins, notes, and simple change.

content.intro: Match coins to prices in a pretend shop.
bullets: Sort coins by size and color.
Check change with a support person.

lessons.title: Lesson 3 — Simple Adding & Subtracting
lessons.summary: Add and subtract small numbers using objects.

content.intro: Use fingers or counters to see numbers clearly.

lessons.title: Lesson 4 — Time Skills & Reading Clocks
lessons.summary: Spot morning, afternoon, and evening on clocks.

content.intro: Use simple clocks and routines to know times.

lessons.title: Lesson 5 — Shopping & Budgeting Basics
lessons.summary: Make lists and check prices calmly.

content.intro: Plan what to buy and how much to spend.

lessons.title: Lesson 6 — Everyday Problem Solving
lessons.summary: Use calm steps to solve simple number problems.

content.intro: Pause, think of options, choose the safest one.

lessons.title: Lesson 7 — Understanding Measurements
lessons.summary: Learn simple lengths, weights, and sizes.

content.intro: Use rulers and cups to compare sizes safely.

lessons.title: Lesson 8 — Using a Calculator & Apps
lessons.summary: Let devices assist your math steps.

content.intro: Calculators and apps keep numbers tidy and confident.

lessons.title: Lesson 9 — Real-Life Money Management
lessons.summary: Pay bills safely and on time.

content.intro: Bills show what to pay and when—keep them in one place.

lessons.title: Lesson 10 — Independent Numeracy Skills
lessons.summary: Use numbers daily with confidence.

content.intro: Combine counting, money, and time to feel independent.
Numbers are friendly and patient here.
steps: Count objects you enjoy (toys, snacks) and say the number out loud.
Match coins and notes to prices in a pretend shop.
Use a daily planner to notice morning, afternoon, and evening times.
Practice slow breathing if a math problem feels tricky.

content.intro: Build calm money habits with simple tools.
steps: Plan a weekly budget with three jars: spend, save, share.
Practice saying no to sudden buys and taking a pause.
Check receipts for mistakes together with a support person.
Use a small calculator for quick totals and confidence.

self-choice-control.title: Self Choice & Control
self-choice-control.blurb: Understand your rights, make choices, and plan your own path.

levels.title: Level 1: Your Voice Matters
levels.summary: Rights, safe choices, and everyday decisions.

lessons.title: Lesson 1 — Knowing Myself & My Needs
lessons.summary: Name what you like, dislike, and need.

content.intro: Understanding yourself helps you make better choices.
bullets: List favourite foods and calming things.

lessons.title: Lesson 2 — Understanding My Rights
lessons.summary: You deserve safety, respect, and choice.

content.intro: Rights cannot be taken away—you can say no.

lessons.title: Lesson 3 — Making Simple Choices
lessons.summary: Practice small daily decisions.

content.intro: Choosing builds independence and confidence.

quiz.question: Choosing pizza instead of pasta is...

lessons.title: Lesson 4 — Communicating What I Want
lessons.summary: Use clear words, writing, or pictures.

content.intro: You are allowed to say what you want or need.
bullets: Your voice matters, even if quiet.

lessons.title: Lesson 5 — Boundaries & Personal Safety
lessons.summary: Your personal stop sign keeps you safe.

content.intro: It is okay to say stop, no, or I need space.
bullets: You choose who can touch you.

quiz.question: Someone asks for your password. That is...

lessons.title: Lesson 6 — Asking for Help & Support
lessons.summary: Asking is strong, not weak.

content.intro: Everyone needs help sometimes—choose trusted people.
bullets: Use phrases like 'Can you help me?'.

quiz.question: Ask for help when you feel...

lessons.title: Lesson 7 — Understanding People & Feelings
lessons.summary: Notice emotions to respond safely.

content.intro: Feelings show on faces and body language.
bullets: Give space when someone looks sad.

quiz.question: If someone is crying, they might feel...
If someone turns away, they might need...

lessons.title: Lesson 8 — Problem Solving & Decision Skills
lessons.summary: Use calm steps to solve disagreements.

content.intro: Pause, list options, pick the safest choice.

quiz.question: Is it OK to ask for help deciding?

lessons.title: Lesson 9 — Self-Advocacy
lessons.summary: Speak up for your needs and comfort.

content.intro: Use strong sentences to explain what works for you.
bullets: Your voice matters even if others disagree.

lessons.title: Lesson 10 — Being Confident & In Control
lessons.summary: Confidence grows with practice and small wins.

content.intro: Try new things, celebrate progress, and ask for help.
bullets: List things you are proud of.

content.intro: You deserve calm spaces to choose what works for you.
steps: List trusted people who can help with big choices.
Practice saying yes, no, or 'I need time' clearly.
Use a feelings scale (1-5) to notice comfort levels.
Celebrate each time you speak up for your needs.

content.intro: Plans give calm structure and freedom.
steps: Build a weekly schedule with rest times and fun time.
Practice boundary phrases like 'I need a quiet break.'
Role-play asking for a change when plans shift.
Pick a support person to review your plan with you.

life-skills-independence.title: Life Skills & Independence
life-skills-independence.blurb: Cooking basics, cleaning routines, money safety, and everyday independence.

levels.title: Level 1: Calm Home Basics
levels.summary: Kitchen safety, tidy routines, and calm checklists.

lessons.title: Lesson 1 — Personal Hygiene & Self-Care Basics
lessons.summary: Daily hygiene keeps you healthy and confident.

content.intro: Brush teeth, shower, wear clean clothes, and use deodorant.
bullets: Clean clothes help you feel fresh.

lessons.title: Lesson 2 — Simple Kitchen & Food Safety Skills
lessons.summary: Stay safe when cooking.

content.intro: Wash hands, separate raw food, and use protection with heat.
bullets: Keep raw and cooked food apart.
Use oven gloves for hot pans.

lessons.title: Lesson 3 — Easy Cooking for Beginners
lessons.summary: Use simple recipes and timers.

content.intro: Microwaves and visual recipes make cooking calm.
bullets: Use a timer to avoid burning food.

lessons.title: Lesson 4 — Cleaning & Home Routines
lessons.summary: Keep spaces tidy with small habits.

content.intro: Make a 5-minute reset routine for comfort.

lessons.title: Lesson 5 — Shopping & Community Safety
lessons.summary: Plan lists and stay aware in public.

content.intro: Use a list and check surroundings like car parks.

quiz.question: In a car park you should...

lessons.title: Lesson 6 — Travel & Getting Around Safely
lessons.summary: Use timetables and cross safely.

content.intro: Plan routes and stay aware of surroundings.

quiz.question: You cross the road by looking...

lessons.title: Lesson 7 — Money & Bills for Everyday Life
lessons.summary: Read bills and pay safely.

content.intro: Bills show amounts and due dates—avoid late fees.
bullets: Find the total and due date.

lessons.title: Lesson 8 — Health, Safety & Emergencies
lessons.summary: Stay calm and know emergency steps.

content.intro: Call 000 for fire, ambulance, or police—share your name and location.
bullets: Ask someone nearby for help if needed.

lessons.title: Lesson 9 — Social Independence & Appointments
lessons.summary: Check in politely and share needs.

content.intro: Greet people, ask questions, and explain what you need.
bullets: Use polite words in public spaces.

lessons.title: Lesson 10 — Living Independently With Confidence
lessons.summary: Combine routines, cooking, cleaning, and budgeting.

content.intro: Independence grows with practice and asking for help when needed.
Small steps make home life feel safe and kind.
steps: Learn kitchen rules: clean hands, clear bench, slow movements.
Sort clothes by color with a simple chart.
Create a 'room reset' checklist for morning and evening.
Use timers with soft sounds to remind you of tasks.

content.intro: Prepare food safely and know what to do if something goes wrong.
steps: Plan three calm meals for the week with a grocery list.
Practice knife safety with soft foods first.
Save emergency numbers in your phone and on the fridge.
Role-play what to do if you smell smoke or need help.

psychology-behaviour.title: Psychology & Behaviour
psychology-behaviour.blurb: Learn about emotions, relationships, and understanding yourself and others.

levels.title: Level 1: Feelings Map
levels.summary: Naming emotions and calm body signals.

lessons.title: Lesson 1 — Understanding My Feelings
lessons.summary: Everyone has feelings and they are normal.

content.intro: Feelings help you understand what you need.
bullets: Common feelings: happy, sad, angry, worried, tired, excited.
Use emoji cards to describe how you feel.

lessons.title: Lesson 2 — Calming My Body & Mind
lessons.summary: Use breathing, stretching, and breaks to stay calm.

content.intro: Calm tools help you make better choices.
bullets: Find a quiet space when needed.

quiz.question: A quiet space can help you feel...

lessons.title: Lesson 3 — Recognising My Triggers
lessons.summary: Notice what makes you feel upset or stressed.

content.intro: Triggers are things that make you feel overwhelmed.
bullets: Examples: loud noise, crowds, being yelled at, waiting long.

lessons.title: Lesson 4 — Healthy Coping Skills
lessons.summary: Use healthy tools to feel better when stressed.

content.intro: Coping skills include breathing, asking for help, and taking breaks.
bullets: Drink water or listen to music.

lessons.title: Lesson 5 — Understanding Other People
lessons.summary: Notice faces, voices, and body language.

content.intro: Understanding others builds kind relationships.
bullets: Look at faces and listen to voices.

lessons.title: Lesson 6 — Communication & Relationships
lessons.summary: Use listening and kind words.

content.intro: Good communication uses honesty, respect, and turn-taking.

lessons.title: Lesson 7 — Positive Behaviour Strategies
lessons.summary: Routines and rewards keep behaviour calm.

content.intro: Positive behaviour grows with routines and coping tools.

lessons.title: Lesson 8 — Handling Conflict & Problems
lessons.summary: Stay safe during disagreements.

content.intro: Conflicts can be handled with calm words and space.
bullets: Ask for help from a trusted person.

lessons.title: Lesson 9 — Building Confidence & Emotional Strength
lessons.summary: Practice skills and celebrate wins.

content.intro: Confidence grows when you try new things and use positive self-talk.

lessons.title: Lesson 10 — Healthy Relationships & Safe Boundaries
lessons.summary: Respect, kindness, and space make relationships safe.

content.intro: Healthy relationships include respect, honesty, and personal space.
Feelings are welcome here. We notice them gently.
steps: Match feelings words to colors or icons that feel right to you.
Notice where feelings show up in your body (warm face, tight hands).
Create a calm-down kit with music, toys, and breathing cards.
Share your feelings map with a trusted person.

levels.title: Level 2: Relationships & Signals
levels.summary: Reading social cues and setting boundaries.

content.intro: Relationships can be clear and kind when we practice.
steps: Practice eye contact alternatives like looking at eyebrows or nose.
Use short scripts for greetings, goodbyes, and needing space.
Draw your support circle: who to call for each feeling.
Set a calm boundary when you feel overwhelmed and need a break.
